metadata.title: Quasipositive and almost positive sectional curvature on finite quotients of Wallach spaces
metadata.abstract: We construct nonnegatively curved metrics on the cyclic and full permutation quotients of the Wallach flag manifolds in dimensions $6$, $12$, and $24$. The metrics are quasipositively curved in all three dimensions and almost positively curved in dimensions $12$ and $24$. The cyclic quotients are orientable with fundamental group $C_3$, and their further full permutation quotients have fundamental group $S_3$; none admits any metric of everywhere positive sectional curvature. For the almost-positive metrics we describe every zero-curvature plane and prove that the zero-point loci have Hausdorff dimensions exactly $11$ and $23$, respectively. A one-step deformation has, in each dimension, an explicit zero locus with nonempty interior. Further nested deformations reduce it to a measure-zero set while leaving a common codimension-one stratum. The argument combines normal forms for horizontal commuting planes with quaternionic rank conditions and a dimension estimate for commuting compressions of skew-symmetric operators. We also determine the possible degrees of arbitrary free finite quotients of the three flag covers and derive order bounds for fundamental groups when the Euler characteristic is nonzero. We have used ChatGPT-6-astra for mathematical exploration and verified and rewritten all the results.
metadata.comment: 30 pages. AI-assisted research work and all results are verified by the authors. Comments are welcome

analysis.progressType: Wallach旗流形有限商的准正与几乎正截曲率
analysis.workSummary: 在6、12、24维Wallach旗流形的循环及全置换商上构造非负截曲率度量：三维数均准正，12和24维进一步几乎正。循环商可定向且π1=C3，全置换商π1=S3；这些商均不容许处处正截曲率。几乎正度量全部零曲率平面被描述，零点集Hausdorff维数恰为11和23。
techniques: 水平交换平面的正规形
斜对称算子压缩的交换性维数估计
analysis.breakthrough: 嵌套形变把单步形变中有内点的零点集降为零测度，同时保留余维一层；另给自由有限商次数及非零Euler示性数下基本群阶的限制。
analysis.limitations: 几乎正结论只在12、24维，准正不等于处处正；单步和嵌套形变的零点集不同。摘要明确ChatGPT-6-astra参与数学探索，具体用途待PDF声明核查，不据探索泛称归因核心ideas。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
